note: What a Google Workspace customer already has, and which outside tool each part replaces: the Google counterpart of m365.json, so a Google school or college also hears 'you already pay for a route with less to sign'. Edition contents and prices are as understood in November 2026 and marked [verify]; they move, and Google renames editions often. Plainflow never overrules the person's choice: it shows the lighter route beside theirs and lets them compare.

gemini_app.label: Gemini app in Google Workspace
gemini_app.does: Chat, drafting and summarising from a prompt, signed in with a school or work account, under the Workspace terms: prompts are not used to train models and stay inside the agreement you already have.
gemini_app.caveat: Admins must turn it on, and on for under-18s separately. It sees what you paste or upload, not your Drive, unless Gemini is also on in Docs and Gmail. Make sure people use the school sign-in, not a personal Google account.
gemini_app.included_note: included with Workspace for Education and Business editions once an admin turns it on [verify]

gemini_in_apps.label: Gemini in Docs, Gmail and Sheets
gemini_in_apps.does: Drafting and summarising inside Docs, Gmail, Sheets and Slides, over the files and mail the person already has access to, under the Workspace terms.
gemini_in_apps.caveat: It can reach anything the person can reach, so sharing settings on Drive matter more than before.
gemini_in_apps.addon_cost: Gemini Education add-on, per user per month, or included in Teaching and Learning Upgrade and Education Plus [verify]

forms.label: Google Forms
forms.does: Surveys, sign-ups and quizzes with answers kept in the tenant, marked automatically if you want.
forms.caveat: Turn off 'collect email addresses' when you do not need to know who answered.

drive_sharing.label: A shared drive, with sharing to the partner's account
drive_sharing.does: Put the file in a shared drive and share it with named accounts, instead of emailing a copy. Access can be withdrawn and every view is logged.
drive_sharing.caveat: Check link sharing is set to specific people, not anyone with the link.

slides.label: Google Slides, Docs and Drawings
slides.does: Posters, displays and newsletters made inside the tenant, with photos staying in Drive under the Workspace terms.
slides.caveat: Fewer templates and effects than a design tool.

appsheet.label: AppSheet over a Google Sheet
appsheet.does: A simple app for forms, trackers and lookups, with the data in a Google Sheet inside the tenant and Google sign-in built in.
appsheet.caveat: AppSheet Core comes with most editions; advanced security and automation need a paid AppSheet plan [verify]. A Sheet cannot do row-level security.
appsheet.included_note: AppSheet Core included with Workspace editions [verify]

looker_studio.label: Looker Studio over a Google Sheet
looker_studio.does: Dashboards and charts over a Sheet or BigQuery, shared to named accounts inside the tenant.
looker_studio.caveat: Looker Studio reports can be shared beyond the tenant; check who each report is shared with.
looker_studio.included_note: Looker Studio is free with a Google account; Looker Studio Pro is paid [verify]

meet_transcription.label: Google Meet transcripts
meet_transcription.does: Meet writes a transcript to Drive for the organiser, so a meeting can be summarised without a third-party note-taker.
meet_transcription.caveat: Everyone in the meeting is told it is being transcribed; you still need a reason to keep it, and a retention period.
meet_transcription.included_note: included with Teaching and Learning Upgrade, Education Plus and Business Standard and above [verify]

vault.label: Google Vault
vault.does: Retention rules and legal hold across Gmail and Drive, so 'how long it's kept' can be enforced rather than promised.
vault.caveat: Vault retains; it does not classify. Someone still decides the rule.
vault.included_note: included with Education Standard, Education Plus and Business Plus [verify]

equivalents.note: Outside tool (product id) to the Google Workspace features that do the same job, best first. 'by_purpose' and 'by_data' cover tools Plainflow doesn't know ('Something else').
